planned_work.title: Independent publisher challenge and remote asset ownership proof
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: The operator can create a single-use 15-minute HTTPS ownership challenge bound to the exact registered publisher and origin; a live verifier must require the exact response bytes over verified TLS, reject redirects, all private/non-global DNS addresses, DNS rebinding, large responses, replaced/expired/replayed challenges and cross-publisher origin conflicts. The public catalog and approved publisher state must not be changed by proof creation or verification, and a separate operator review is required.

planned_work.title: Automatic public catalog gateway and cache revocation
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Operator-hosted anonymous HTTPS gateway reads only reviewed, active publisher releases and matching hash-verified local assets; fails closed on revocation, DB/error/tamper, sets no-store and strict CORS, delivers automatic client refresh without Pages pushes, and clears revoked running apps. No private DAPI credentials, automatic release or operator approval; real HTTPS/Pages acceptance required.

planned_work.title: Publish a reviewed first-party playable Checkers preview via manual Pages approval
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Reviewed, self-contained Checkers game is playable as an explicit first-party manual Pages preview; catalog and assets SHA-256 aligned; American capture/king/Staff rules tested; default remains empty; production live gateway not bypassed; operator verifies real browser and rollback.

risks: The installed v0.5.12 ZIP is still operator-unverified although its exact commit 435872423... passed Linux and Windows GitHub Actions.

v0.5.14 Gateway performs full SHA-256 verification on each request and may require performance optimization for large catalogs; do not introduce caching without durable invalidation and fail-closed acceptance.
A broken reverse proxy or intermediary ignoring no-store can serve stale data; verify no-store and TLS at public edge.
An already-running/background browser is not instantaneously revoked; current foreground interval is 60 seconds. Game authorization must remain authoritative server-side.
Operator must configure and maintain read-only SQLite/asset access and an HTTPS reverse proxy; this ZIP deliberately does not deploy a service or publish Pages.
Real publisher HTTPS origin challenge and v3→v4 production migration remain separately operator-unverified.
blockers: Live TLS proxy and Pages publication, operator asset acceptance, and production rollout require explicit operator actions; no unattended auto-activation.
notes: v0.5.0 supplies a static build and operator-dispatched publication workflow, not an automated deployment.
Shared Social sign-in and game installation remain unimplemented; do not expose a database API key in Pages.
Game public catalog is deliberately empty until reviewed bytes and snapshot are published.
v0.5.1 adds an explicit Life/hosted-game registration design and sample only; current v1 cannot register current multi-MiB Life build.
Unknown root Looprd fields are rejected; discovery must use existing handlers/metadata or upstream spec extension, never fabricated root atrium field.
v0.5.14 adds live anonymous gateway and Pages optional config; static preview remains deliberately empty unless separately reviewed. Not a user-login, hosted game support or DAPI token proxy.
